in_sanskrit.name: Sasmita
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess who brings good fortune and auspiciousness

in_marathi.name: Sasmita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Wisdom and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sasmita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sasmita is a Sanskrit name that translates to 'She who is adorned with knowledge'. In Hindu mythology, Sasmita is a name of Goddess Saraswati, who is the goddess of knowledge, music, art, wisdom, and learning.
